statement:
I'll look up the invoice record first.
The recorded value is not safe to act on as instructed: the record contradicts itself — the payment history shows this invoice already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291, while the status field still reads "unpaid, due," so paying now risks a duplicate $148,300 disbursement.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record "contradicts itself" — already "paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291" — so paying would be a duplicate $148,300 disbursement.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
